description: Unit tests for the CmduParserStreamImpl class, testing parsing of CMDU messages from a buffer, including failure cases for incomplete or invalid messages and a success case.

classes.name: CmduParserStreamImplTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CmduParserStreamImpl parsing functionality.

methods.name: parse_cmdu_should_fail_with_incomplete_header
methods.description: Test case where the buffer does not contain a complete header, expecting parse to fail.

methods.name: parse_cmdu_should_fail_with_incomplete_message
methods.description: Test case where the buffer contains only the header but not the full message, expecting parse to fail.

methods.name: parse_cmdu_should_fail_with_invalid_message
methods.description: Test case where the message is invalid (e.g., incomplete message), expecting parse to fail.

methods.name: parse_cmdu_should_succeed
methods.description: Test case where a valid CMDU message is parsed successfully, verifying message type and MAC addresses.
